---
name: plan-feature
description: Analyze and plan a feature before implementation.
agent: ask
---

Analyze the requested feature in this repository.

1. Inspect only the files needed to understand the current architecture and conventions.
2. Identify relevant routes, components, styles, data flow, and dependencies.
3. Propose the smallest maintainable implementation.
4. List files likely to change and any risks or unanswered questions.
5. Do not edit files yet.

Keep the plan concise and specific to this codebase. Do not recommend dependencies unless necessary.
